List the datasets bundled with the package

Source: R/datasets.R
list_datasets.Rd

Returns one row per dataset that the package's loaders and add_*() functions can use, with its coverage, data type, the panel units it supports, and the prefix of the columns it adds. Use cn_cite() with the dataset value to get the citation.

Usage

list_datasets(
  topic = c("all", "conflict", "gdp", "population", "military", "leaders", "vdem")
)

Arguments

topic

Which datasets to list: "all" (default), "conflict", "gdp", "population", "military", "leaders", or "vdem".

Value

A data frame with columns:

dataset

Value to pass as dataset =.

topic

Topic, as in topic.

name

Name of the source.

version

Bundled version.

load_function, add_function

The loader and the panel function that use it.

record

What one source record is: an event, an episode or campaign, a campaign phase, a conflict-year, or a country-year.

start_year, end_year

Years covered.

countries

Which countries the source covers.

units

Panel units at which the data vary: annual data are repeated across the periods of a year in finer panels.

prefix

Prefix of the columns added to a panel.

zero_fill

For conflict datasets, how add_conflict(fill_zero = TRUE) decides which country-years the source covers (see add_conflict()).
